def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_investment = 250_000
    ending_fund_value = 320_000
    management_fee_rate = 0.04
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    profit = ending_fund_value - initial_investment
    management_fee = ending_fund_value * management_fee_rate
    incentive_fee = profit * incentive_fee_rate
    investor_value = ending_fund_value - management_fee - incentive_fee
    answer = round((investor_value / initial_investment - 1) * 100, 1)

    # return answer
    return answer
